blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT— The Port of Subic has received its first shipment of BYD passenger vehicles intended for sale in the country, with authorities hoping the initial delivery would lead to more car imports through this freeport. The Bureau of Customs (BOC) at the Port of Subic said on Thursday that the initial shipment consisted of 100 BYD vehicles in various models and variants, imported as a test run that could pave the way for succeeding shipments. The vehicles were imported for consumption entry, a customs procedure for goods intended for domestic use or sale after applicable import requirements were met. […]...
